entries.symptom: TS2593: Cannot find name 'describe'
entries.cause: TypeScript 6 defaults types to [], so the Jest globals are unknown
entries.fix: Give the test programs types: ["jest"] (the root program ["jest", "node"])

entries.symptom: TS2591: Cannot find name 'process' (or a node: module) in app code or scripts
entries.cause: The program has no Node types
entries.fix: App code: src/app-env.d.ts declares process for EXPO_PUBLIC_* (never add Node types to app code); Node scripts: the root program with types node

entries.symptom: TS4111 on process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT or process.argv
entries.cause: noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature requires bracket access unless the property is declared
entries.fix: Declare every EXPO_PUBLIC_* in src/env.d.ts (Expo inlines only dot access); use bracket access in Node code

entries.symptom: TS1294: This syntax is not allowed when erasableSyntaxOnly is enabled (an enum, a namespace, a constructor parameter property)
entries.cause: erasableSyntaxOnly (needed for Node type stripping) forbids syntax that emits code
entries.fix: Use string-literal unions and 'as const' objects; plain constructor fields

entries.symptom: exactOptionalPropertyTypes rejects an explicit undefined prop
entries.cause: Some third-party prop types do not include undefined
entries.fix: Conditional spread: {...(x ? { prop: value } : {})}; never relax the flag for the whole program

entries.symptom: TS2353 or TS2559 on TextStyle after expo-env.d.ts entered a program
entries.cause: expo/types still clashes with React Native's Strict TypeScript API on SDK 57
entries.fix: List expo-env.d.ts in the root tsconfig include and exclude (so expo start has nothing to add and it never enters a program); src/app-env.d.ts declares what is needed

entries.symptom: @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-argument on process.env['X'] in app.config.ts once an Expo module is imported anywhere in the program
entries.cause: expo-modules-core's globals turn process.env members into any in the root program
entries.fix: Pass the whole process.env to the variant resolver (resolveAppVariant(process.env)) instead of single members

entries.symptom: TS2769 No overload matches this call: Argument of type '"<route>"' is not assignable to parameter of type 'never' at navigation calls
entries.cause: The program never sees the global route-type augmentation (a .d.ts that nothing imports), so the route list is empty there
entries.fix: With Expo Router keep typed routes on and include the generated expo-env.d.ts types where the router reads them (or the router's typed hrefs); with React Navigation include the RootParamList declaration file in the tsconfig of every program that type-checks navigation

entries.symptom: A src/node_modules/ folder appears after npm run typecheck
entries.cause: tsBuildInfoFile: '${configDir}/node_modules/...' in a shared base resolves against the app program's folder
entries.fix: Point src/tsconfig.json's build info at the root cache folder

entries.symptom: react-native/Libraries/* imports become type errors after an upgrade
entries.cause: React Native's Strict TypeScript API (the default from RN 0.87) does not export deep paths
entries.fix: Never deep-import; opt into customConditions ['react-native-strict-api'] now

entries.symptom: A Node script cannot import '@/...'
entries.cause: Node type stripping ignores tsconfig paths
entries.fix: Node scripts import with relative paths and explicit .ts extensions (or a package self-reference in a multi-package repo)

entries.symptom: A tsconfig copied from a guide sets baseUrl and paths that disagree with the template
entries.cause: Guides lag the template (extends expo/tsconfig.base, paths '@/*' to './src/*', no baseUrl)
entries.fix: Copy the canonical tsconfig set; aliases live only in the root tsconfig paths

entries.symptom: A port adapter fails tsc when the vendor call is async
entries.cause: The result type was ReturnType<...>, which is a Promise for an async call
entries.fix: Use Awaited<ReturnType<...>>

entries.symptom: Assertion-free tests, duplicate titles and conditional expects pass lint
entries.cause: The test block spread jest flat/recommended and flat/style into one object, so the second rules key replaced the first
entries.fix: Use extends: [jest.configs['flat/recommended'], jest.configs['flat/style']]; the gate guardrail asserts jest/expect-expect is active

entries.symptom: `fireEvent.press` is sync and does not need `await`
entries.cause: testing-library's no-await-sync-events contradicts RNTL 14, where fireEvent returns a Promise
entries.fix: Turn testing-library/no-await-sync-events off; keep await-async-events and no-floating-promises
match: is sync and does not need `?await

entries.symptom: The physical-direction ban fires on { left, right } keys in pure data (a board, a geometry helper)
entries.cause: The selector matched any object key, but only styles are subject to RTL rules
entries.fix: Scope the selector to style contexts (StyleSheet.create, style props, *Style-typed variables)

entries.symptom: An exhaustive switch fails 'complexity of 12. Maximum allowed is 10'
entries.cause: ESLint 9 counts every case, ?., ??, default parameter and logical assignment
entries.fix: complexity: ['error', { max: 10, variant: 'modified' }] (a switch counts once); sonarjs cognitive complexity still bounds nesting

entries.symptom: new Date() or performance.now() pass lint in pure logic
entries.cause: Only Date.now and Math.random were banned
entries.fix: Ban NewExpression[callee.name='Date'][arguments.length=0] and performance.now there too; time comes from the clock port

entries.symptom: <Image source={{ uri: "https://..." }} /> passes lint in an app that routes network through a port
entries.cause: Only fetch was banned, but a remote image or a URL literal also makes a request
entries.fix: Ban http(s)://, ws(s):// literals outside the allowed link and API config files

entries.symptom: exhaustive-deps, incompatible-library or unsupported-syntax only warn
entries.cause: eslint-plugin-react-hooks recommended marks them warn
entries.fix: Run eslint with --max-warnings 0 and raise them to error

entries.symptom: An // eslint-disable comment has no effect and is reported
entries.cause: linterOptions.noInlineConfig and reportUnusedDisableDirectives are on
entries.fix: Fix the code, or add a named file-level exemption in eslint.config.mjs with the reviewer's agreement and a Gate-Change trailer
match: has no effect because you have 'noInlineConfig'

entries.symptom: A later config block silently drops restricted paths of an earlier block
entries.cause: In flat config a later block replaces (not merges) the options of the same rule
entries.fix: Repeat the shared paths (build the blocks from shared constants)

entries.symptom: import/order wants a blank line between value and type imports of the same module
entries.cause: 'type' is its own group with newlines-between always
entries.fix: Put import type statements in a final group after a blank line
match: There should be at least one empty line between import groups

entries.symptom: @typescript-eslint/unbound-method flags expect(sdk.method) in tests
entries.cause: Library-typed methods look unbound
entries.fix: Type the mock locally (jest.mocked) or use jest/unbound-method in tests

entries.symptom: naming-convention errors in a __mocks__ file
entries.cause: The mock mirrors the library's PascalCase exports
entries.fix: Turn naming-convention off for __mocks__/**

entries.symptom: expo/no-dynamic-env-var in app code
entries.cause: process.env['X'] or a computed name; Expo inlines only literal dot access
entries.fix: Use process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_X literally in app code; read other variables in app.config.ts

entries.symptom: @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports on a require() in app code
entries.cause: Only the test-only gate may call require() (its literal comparison lets Metro drop the module)
entries.fix: Use imports; the one file-level exemption is src/test-only.ts

entries.symptom: max-lines fails on a data table, palette or catalog file
entries.cause: Large data tables were written as TypeScript
entries.fix: Move data to JSON (import with { type: "json" }); split code by responsibility, not by line count

entries.symptom: New react-hooks errors appear after a dependency bump
entries.cause: React Compiler rules arrive with eslint-plugin-react-hooks minor versions
entries.fix: Run lint after every bump and fix the code; never turn the rule off

entries.symptom: A clock adapter, direction module or text primitive suddenly fails lint
entries.cause: The ESLint exemptions name exact files; the file was renamed or moved
entries.fix: Keep the canonical file names; if a rename is right, change the exemption glob with a Gate-Change trailer

entries.symptom: The gate guardrail fails: a no-restricted-properties message differs from the recorded one
entries.cause: The guardrail compares the restricted-property messages word for word
entries.fix: Never reword them; copy eslint.config.mjs byte for byte from the canonical file

entries.symptom: prettier --check fails on a template right after its placeholders were filled
entries.cause: Filled values change line lengths, so the wrapping no longer matches Prettier
entries.fix: Run npx prettier --write on the filled files before lint and commit

entries.symptom: IS_DEBUG_BUILD rejected: must have one of the following prefixes
entries.cause: The boolean prefix rule allowed only camelCase prefixes
entries.fix: Allow UPPER_CASE with IS_/HAS_/CAN_/SHOULD_/DID_/WILL_/WAS_ prefixes
match: must have one of the following prefixes

entries.symptom: const { granted } = ... or ({ disabled }: Props) rejected by naming-convention
entries.cause: Destructured booleans need the is/has prefix too
entries.fix: Rename while destructuring: { granted: isGranted }

entries.symptom: ({ pressed }) in a style callback fails naming-convention
entries.cause: Boolean parameter naming applies to callback parameters
entries.fix: Rename: ({ pressed: isPressed })

entries.symptom: check-file/filename-blocklist crashes with "invalid pattern"
entries.cause: The suggestion was free text
entries.fix: Give the rule a glob suggestion such as '**/[a-z]*-[a-z]*.ts'

entries.symptom: jest/valid-title: should match /^(can|[a-z]+s)\b/u
entries.cause: Test titles start with a third-person verb or "can"
entries.fix: Write it('returns ...') or it('can ...'), not it('return ...')

entries.symptom: jest/prefer-to-be: Use toBe when expecting primitive literals
entries.cause: toStrictEqual is rejected for numbers, strings and booleans
entries.fix: toBe for a primitive, toStrictEqual for an object or array

entries.symptom: no-unused-styles reports every key as unused ("undefined.base")
entries.cause: makeStyles returned StyleSheet.create(...) directly
entries.fix: Use a block body: const styles = StyleSheet.create(...); return styles;

entries.symptom: props.items.push() is not flagged by the compiler rules
entries.cause: The React Compiler lint does not see array mutation through props
entries.fix: Type props readonly (readonly T[])

entries.symptom: React Compiler skips a component or hook: "value blocks within a try/catch"
entries.cause: The compiler bails out on some try/catch shapes
entries.fix: Move the try/catch into a plain helper function the hook calls

entries.symptom: max-params fails on a draw or render helper with many inputs
entries.cause: The limit is three parameters
entries.fix: Pass one frame object ({ view, colors, layout, ... })
